testsuite.name: org.thoughtcrime.securesms.conversation.ConversationUpdateTickTest

testcase.name: Given onResume not invoked, then I expect zero invocations of onTick
Given no time has passed after onResume is invoked, then I expect no invocations of onTick
Given onResume then onPause is invoked, when timeout passes, then I expect no invocation of onTick
Given onResume is invoked, when half timeout passes, then I expect no invocations of onTick
Given onResume is invoked, when timeout passes, then I expect one invocation of onTick
Given onResume is invoked, when timeout passes five times, then I expect five invocations of onTick
